# CRAFT Content

> CRAFT Content is a free web app and AI connector with nine content tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for demand generation heads and marketing teams. Give it a customer story, a topic or a draft, and it returns a case study, a newsletter or a webinar script. Add https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf, no sign-in. In ChatGPT, you can also install the Helix Content Studio plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae0ffcb37a88191b85db4318d40edb5

- Web app (no sign-in): https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/
- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf: https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/connect/
- Use it in ChatGPT: install the Helix Content Studio plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae0ffcb37a88191b85db4318d40edb5
- Docs (MCP and REST, every field): https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/docs/
- FAQ: https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/faq/
- Privacy policy: https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/privacy/
- Terms of use: https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/terms/
- Hosted version 2.2.24 with 9 tools. Local stdio command: `npx -y @shashwatgtmalpha/craft-content-mcp`. npm latest on 15 November 2026: 2.2.22.
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-content-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)
- All connectors and Helix skills packages: https://tools.gtmhelix.com/

## Tools

- [Case Study Generator](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/case-study-generator/) (`case_study_generator`): Helps you turn a customer result into a case study, built from the customer name, your product and the challenge, solution and results you give (mode full), or an interview kit to collect them (mode discovery). Optional customer industry, quote, interview notes and business model fit the wording to the customer. Returns a headline, the story with each result you list, a customer quote, social and email copy, and sector notes when the sector can be read from your text. A bracket marks anything you did not give. Ask whether written customer approval covers the exact material and intended use.
- [Newsletter Builder](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/newsletter-builder/) (`newsletter_builder`): Helps you decide what goes in a newsletter issue and which subject line to test, from your topic and the action you want readers to take. Optional key points, audience segment, newsletter type, tone, earlier topics and your product fit it to the reader. Returns a first draft with subject line and preview, an opening, a short section for each key point, your call to action as the button, A/B subject lines, other opening hooks and sector notes. It adds no statistic or customer story and says what it did not get. Ask whether written customer approval covers the exact material and intended use.
- [Webinar Script](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/webinar-script/) (`webinar_script`): Helps you plan a webinar that leads to meetings, from your topic, target audience and webinar type. Optional duration, key takeaways, speakers, polls, product mention level, your product and business model shape it. Returns a run of show, a full spoken script with speaker lines and on screen cues, polls with answer options, likely questions with answers, a follow up email sequence and sector notes. It uses only what you gave and says what it did not get. Ask whether written customer approval covers the exact material and intended use.
- [Content Repurposer](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/content-repurposer/) (`content_repurposer`): Helps you get more from a single piece of content: it needs the source text and its type. Optional target formats, brand voice and a key message steer the result. Returns versions for other channels (a LinkedIn post, an X thread, an email, a blog summary and quote cards), each written from whole sentences of your source with key points kept in source order. Claims it cannot support are listed to source, and any format it does not know is named. Ask whether written customer approval covers the exact material and intended use.
- [Thought Leadership Series](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/thought-leadership-series/) (`thought_leadership_series`): Helps you decide what to publish to make your point of view known, from your topic, your take and the reader you write for. Optional proof points, author background, number of articles and article style shape it. Returns, for each article, a headline and a short first draft with the objection it answers, your proof and a way to test the idea, a promotional post for each, a publishing order and sector notes. Your words are quoted as written and no result, customer or figure is invented. Ask whether written customer approval covers the exact material and intended use.
- [Testimonial Capture](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/testimonial-capture/) (`testimonial_capture`): Helps you ask a happy customer for a testimonial, from the customer's name, company, success story and the type of testimonial you want. Optional role, relationship, intended use, incentive, your product and business model fit it to the customer. Returns a request email, interview questions for the customer's role and sector, quote drafts for the customer to edit and a sign off checklist. It uses your product name when you give it and says so when you do not. Ask whether written customer approval covers the exact material and intended use.
- [Sales Enablement Content](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/sales-enablement-content/) (`sales_enablement_content`): Helps you decide what sellers should say at each stage of a deal, from your product, the persona you sell to and your proof points. Optional objections, value propositions, competitor objections, price context, sales stage and business model shape it. Returns a pitch order, an answer to each objection with the proof point that fits it, competitor responses, discovery questions and follow up templates. Without objections it suggests the ones your sector raises.
- [CRAFT Content Improver](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/craft-content-improver/) (`craft_content_improver`): Helps you decide whether a draft is ready to publish and what to fix first, from the pasted copy and its content type. Optional goal, audience and tone preference refine the review. Returns a score for each area (buzzwords, claims that need proof, fragments, unfilled merge fields, claims about the reader, a missing figure or ask) with each deduction quoted from your text, and the edits it made. If it finds nothing to edit, it says so and prints no improved version.
- [Turn this customer result into content](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/customer-result-to-content/) (`customer_result_to_content`): Turn this customer win into a case study, a post and a newsletter without changing the number. Needs the exact result sentence with its qualifier and source label, source and date, your role, approval, your own view and a reader action. Returns a proof card, first drafts and a sentence check. Optional proof details expose gaps. Written approval is required for your own customer; without it, returns the card and questions only. Chat collects the facts; the results view shows them. No form.

## Questions and answers

### What is CRAFT Content?

CRAFT Content is a free web app and AI connector with nine content tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for demand generation heads and marketing teams. Give it a customer story, a topic or a draft, and it returns a case study, a newsletter or a webinar script. Add https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf, no sign-in. In ChatGPT, you can also install the Helix Content Studio plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae0ffcb37a88191b85db4318d40edb5

### Is CRAFT Content free, and do I need an account?

It is free, and there is no account or sign-in. Use the tools in your browser here, or add them to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf as a connector.

### Does it use AI to write the answers?

No. Each tool applies fixed rules in the CRAFT Content code to the inputs you give it. It does not call an AI model and does not look anything up. When you use it from Claude or another assistant, that assistant writes around the tool's answer.

### What happens to what I type?

It is sent to this site's server, used once to build the answer, and dropped when the answer is sent back. What you type and the answer are not stored, and nothing you type is logged. Only an anonymous count of tool calls is kept. The privacy page has the details.

### How do I use CRAFT Content in Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, select + and then Add custom connector. Name it CRAFT Content, paste https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/mcp and leave the sign-in fields empty. The page Connect your app covers Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf too.

### Who built it?

Shashwat Ghosh, Co-Founder and Fractional CMO of Helix GTM Consulting, the brand he has worked under in Bengaluru since 2022. He has 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience, and created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Brand Messaging Methodology.

### Why does the newsletter builder give a different preview line each time?

The Newsletter Builder picks its preview line at random from a short list. Everything else it returns depends on your inputs and the current year.

### Why do some answers look like templates?

Several tools return a structured plan with [placeholders] where your inputs did not give a fact. When an answer shows a benchmark, target, rate, weight or other figure you did not supply, it is labelled "Example figure: replace with your own". Figures calculated from your inputs are not labelled. Suggested lengths, timings and counts are marked as suggestions. Replace every example and placeholder before you use the result.

### Can I call the tools from my own code?

Yes. Send POST https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/api/tools/<tool name> with a JSON body {"input": {...}}. The Docs page lists every field. Please keep to the rate limit of 30 requests per minute.

### Is the source code public?

Yes, at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-content-mcp under the MIT licence. The npm package @shashwatgtmalpha/craft-content-mcp runs these tools locally; it can lag behind this site until a new version is published.

### Who is CRAFT Content not ideal for?

Teams that want finished, on-brand copy: each tool returns a structured draft to edit, with placeholders where your inputs gave no fact. Anyone who needs research or quotes gathered for them: the tools look nothing up; they work from the story and facts you give, and anything they add themselves is marked as an example, a suggestion or a placeholder. Teams that need saved drafts or approvals: answers are not stored, so keep each result where you keep your work.

### How do I report a problem?

Email shashwat@gtmhelix.com or open an issue at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-content-mcp/issues.

## Buyer routes

- [All Helix tools](https://tools.gtmhelix.com/tools/): 52 tools and 37 different skills, 89 in all, in six connectors and nine plugins.
- [Case Study Generator](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/case-study-generator/): Build a B2B case study from one customer result you can support with evidence. Enter the challenge, work done and measured change, then review the draft against the source. Keep the period and limits beside each figure. Collect a real approved quote before sharing customer words in the finished story.
- [Turn this customer result into content](https://craft-content.gtmhelix.com/tools/customer-result-to-content/) (`customer_result_to_content`): One proof card, an approval gate, four first drafts and an exact sentence check. Use in chat; there is no form.
